name: Othello
message: The poor soul sat singing by a tree, sing all a green willow...

name: Othello
message: Her hand on her bosom, her head on her knee...

name: Othello
message: The fresh streams ran by her, and murmur'd her moans...

name: Othello
message: Her salt tears fell from her, and soften'd the stones...

name: Othello
message: Yes. But so are many things in this age. You know, you remind me a little of the woman in the song. You have that air of sadness about you.

name: Ophelia
message: You were singing alone. Do you not sing to music?

name: Othello
message: That so! Why, you should have him come down and we'll raise a real hell sometime, seeing who is the master among us.
